# Grokipedia

> A comprehensive encyclopedia covering classic and contemporary music recordings, songs, and ballistics ammunition with detailed chart performance, production history, and cultural impact analysis.

Grokipedia documents notable songs, albums, and rifle cartridges with attention to chart performance across Billboard, UK Charts, and international markets. The site emphasizes music production credits, ballistic specifications, and cultural significance across multiple decades.

## Key Topics

- Power ballads
- Chart performance
- Album reviews
- Rifle cartridges
- Music production
- Billboard Hot 100
- UK Singles Chart
- Rimfire ammunition
- 1980s pop-rock
- Song analysis
- Varmint hunting
- Ballistics
- Music biography
- Cultural impact
- Ammunition history

## Classic Pop & Rock Ballads

- [(They Long to Be) Close to You](https://grokipedia.com/page/(They_Long_to_Be)_Close_to_You): Bacharach-David pop ballad made famous by The Carpenters
- [(I Just) Died in Your Arms](https://grokipedia.com/page/(I_Just)_Died_in_Your_Arms): Cutting Crew's 1986 power ballad by Nick Van Eede
- [(Si Si) Je Suis un Rock Star](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Si_Si)_Je_Suis_un_Rock_Star): Bill Wyman's 1981 solo single from Rolling Stones bassist
- [(When You Gonna) Give It Up to Me](https://grokipedia.com/page/(When_You_Gonna)_Give_It_Up_to_Me): Sean Paul & Keyshia Cole's 2006 reggae fusion single

## Albums & Live Recordings

- [...And Then There Were Three...](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Then_There_Were_Three...): Genesis's 1978 album marking band's transition to trio
- [...I Care Because You Do](https://grokipedia.com/page/...I_Care_Because_You_Do): Aphex Twin's 1995 IDM album on Warp Records
- [...The Dandy Warhols Come Down](https://grokipedia.com/page/...The_Dandy_Warhols_Come_Down): Dandy Warhols' 1997 alternative rock album via Capitol Records
- [...Live in Chicago](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Live_in_Chicago): Panic! at the Disco's 2008 live concert album and film
- [(sic)nesses](https://grokipedia.com/page/(sic)nesses): Slipknot's 2009 live video album from Download Festival

## Rifle Cartridges & Ammunition

- [.277 Fury](https://grokipedia.com/page/.277_Fury): SIG Sauer's military rifle cartridge for modern combat
- [.17 Mach IV](https://grokipedia.com/page/.17_Mach_IV): Wildcat rifle cartridge by Vern O'Brien introduced 1962
- [.17 HM2](https://grokipedia.com/page/.17_HM2): Hornady's 2004 rimfire cartridge for varmint hunting
- [.22 Winchester Automatic](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_Winchester_Automatic): Obsolete Winchester rimfire cartridge from 1903
